description: Implementation of the WindowManagerConnector class, managing window display creation, registration with window manager, and display info retrieval within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector
classes.description: Manages window display creation and registration with the window manager, including display info retrieval.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Handles window manager notifications, such as user inactivity events.

methods.name: initializePlugin
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by querying and registering with the window manager.

methods.name: releasePlugin
methods.description: Unregisters and releases the window manager interface.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Creates a new display with specified application instance ID, display name, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: isPluginInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether the plugin has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves display information including XDG directory and Wayland display name.
